create.name: Pir Zia Inayat Khan
create.bio:
Pir Zia Inayat Khan leads the Inayatiyya, the Sufi order that grew from the work of his grandfather, the Indian musician and mystic Hazrat Inayat Khan. Born to Taj Inayat and the Sufi teacher Pir Vilayat Inayat Khan, he grew up in the United States, read Persian literature at the University of London and earned a doctorate in religion at Duke University. His father trained him in the Sufi path and named him as successor in 2000, and since 2004 he has guided the order's communities across several continents as its Pir-o-Murshid.

His teaching centres on the universalist Sufism of his lineage: meditation, breath, zikr, contemplation of nature and the shared mystical ground of the world's faiths. He founded Suluk Academy, a two-year school of Sufi study and practice offered in person and online, and he teaches retreats, weekend programmes and book events in North America, Europe and India. He works mainly from two houses, the Astana in Richmond, Virginia, and Fazal Manzil in Suresnes near Paris. His books include Mingled Waters, Saracen Chivalry, Immortality: A Traveler's Guide and Tears from the Mother of the Sun, a cycle of legends illustrated by Amruta Patil.

books.title: Tears from the Mother of the Sun: A Secret History of the World
books.author: Pir Zia Inayat Khan
books.description: A short novel in prose and rhymed verse in which a spirit guide unfolds to the Persian poet Firdausi a hidden history of humanity's sages, from the first angels to the Grail. Full-colour paintings by Amruta Patil accompany the legends.

books.title: Mingled Waters: Sufism and the Mystical Unity of Religions
books.author: Pir Zia Inayat Khan
books.description: Reads the mystical core of six faiths, from Hinduism and Buddhism to Judaism, Christianity, Islam and the Zoroastrian tradition, through a Sufi lens. It draws on scripture, poetry and stories to trace the common source beneath the faiths.

books.title: Immortality: A Traveler's Guide
books.author: Pir Zia Inayat Khan
books.description: One hundred and eighty passages from Hazrat Inayat Khan's teachings on the soul's journey, each paired with Pir Zia's commentary and a practice to try. It can be read alone or as a way into the longer source texts.

books.title: Saracen Chivalry: Counsels on Valor, Generosity and the Mystical Quest
books.author: Pir Zia Inayat Khan
books.description: Sufi teaching on spiritual chivalry told through a dying queen's letter of advice to her infant son, drawn from a medieval Grail romance. Her counsels set out the virtues the prince will need on his quest.
